# Data Appendix {#sec-data-appendix .unnumbered}

Every dataset used in this book, in one place. The files live in the book's `practice/data/` folder; click a file name to download it. Put downloaded files in your own project's `data/` folder, untouched, and do all your work in a script.

The datasets fall into two groups. The first group is real data, drawn from the agencies cited with each entry. The second group is synthetic data constructed for this course; those files look like real farm records but the values are generated, so nothing in them describes an actual farm.

## Real datasets {.unnumbered}

### Saskatchewan RM crop yields {.unnumbered}

Average yields for every Saskatchewan Rural Municipality. Source: @scic_rm_yields.

- [`rm_yields_1990_2025.csv`](practice/data/rm_yields_1990_2025.csv) -- the long form: 71,104 rows, one per RM-year-crop, for eight crops from 1990 to 2025. Columns `Year`, `RM`, `Crop`, `Yield`, `Unit`. Lentils are recorded in pounds per acre and every other crop in bushels per acre; the `Unit` column says which. Used in the Module 1 and Module 2 test banks.
- [`rm_canola_yields_1990_2025.csv`](practice/data/rm_canola_yields_1990_2025.csv) -- the canola rows only, for the Module 2 test bank's summary-statistics questions.
- [`rm_yields_1990plus.csv`](practice/data/rm_yields_1990plus.csv) -- the wide form: 10,649 rows, one per RM-year, with one column per crop. Used in Module 1, where the wide layout suits PivotTables.
- [`rm_yields_2015_2024.csv`](practice/data/rm_yields_2015_2024.csv) -- a wide subset (2,950 rows, ten years, six crops) used in Modules 3 and 4.

### Saskatchewan variety yields {.unnumbered}

Variety-level yields and acres by SCIC risk zone. Source: @scic_smp.

- [`sask_variety_yields.csv`](practice/data/sask_variety_yields.csv) -- 13,625 rows, one per risk-zone-crop-variety-year, 2021 to 2025. Columns `Risk_Zone`, `Crop`, `Variety`, `Year`, `Acres`, `Yield`. Suppressed observations have missing acres and yield. The charts in Module 4 and the AI exercises in Module 5 are built from this file.
- [`sask_barley_2025.xlsx`](practice/data/sask_barley_2025.xlsx) / [`sask_barley_2025.csv`](practice/data/sask_barley_2025.csv) -- 2025 barley varieties, provincial acres and average yield. The workbook version has the title rows and multiple sheets that Module 3's Excel-import section works through.

### Manitoba wheat variety yields {.unnumbered}

MASC's variety-level spring wheat yields by municipality, 2020 to 2025. Source: @masc_variety.

- [`mb_wheat_varieties.csv`](practice/data/mb_wheat_varieties.csv) -- 5,358 rows, one per municipality-variety-year. Columns `Year`, `Municipality`, `Variety`, `Farms`, `Acres`, `Yield_bu_ac`, `Reported`. Where too few farms grew a variety the row is suppressed for privacy: `Reported` is FALSE and the numeric columns are missing. Used in the Module 1 and Module 2 test banks.
- [`mb_wheat_reported_2020_2025.csv`](practice/data/mb_wheat_reported_2020_2025.csv) -- the 2,398 reported rows only.

### Canada field crops {.unnumbered}

Statistics Canada's provincial estimates of seeded area and yield. Source: @statcan_field_crops.

- [`statcan_field_crops.csv`](practice/data/statcan_field_crops.csv) -- 1,067 rows, one per province-crop-year, thirteen crops from 2015 to 2025. Columns `Year`, `Province`, `Crop`, `Seeded_acres`, `Yield_bu_ac`. Used in the Module 1 and Module 2 test banks.
- [`statcan_spring_wheat_2015_2025.csv`](practice/data/statcan_spring_wheat_2015_2025.csv) -- the 94 spring wheat rows only.

### RM lookup table {.unnumbered}

- [`rm_lookup.csv`](practice/data/rm_lookup.csv) -- one row per Saskatchewan RM (296 rows): name, census division, 2021 population, and the nearest of sixteen weather stations with its distance. Compiled for this course from Statistics Canada 2021 Census counts. Used in Module 3's merging chapter.

### Station precipitation {.unnumbered}

- [`station_precip.csv`](practice/data/station_precip.csv) -- May-to-August precipitation for sixteen Saskatchewan weather stations, 2015 to 2024 (160 rows), with a count of days missing a reading. Compiled from Environment and Climate Change Canada historical climate records. Used in Module 3's merging chapter.

## Synthetic datasets {.unnumbered}

### Canola trial {.unnumbered}

- [`canola_trial.csv`](practice/data/canola_trial.csv) -- 120 canola fields with fertilizer rate, growing-season rainfall, variety, and yield. Three fields have missing rainfall values, on purpose. This is the running example in Module 2's data chapters and returns in Modules 3, 4 and 7.

### Field yields {.unnumbered}

- [`field_yields.csv`](practice/data/field_yields.csv) -- sixty hypothetical canola fields with region, variety, acres, yield, and seeding date.

### Saskatchewan wheat fields, 2025 {.unnumbered}

- [`sask_wheat_2025.csv`](practice/data/sask_wheat_2025.csv) -- field-level wheat records with soil zone, variety, acres, yield, protein, and seeding rate. Constructed for the course; the soil-zone yield differences are patterned on real ones. Used in Module 6's reporting examples and the Module 2 practice pages.

### Grain deliveries (messy) {.unnumbered}

- [`grain_deliveries_messy.csv`](practice/data/grain_deliveries_messy.csv) -- elevator delivery tickets constructed to contain the problems Module 3's cleaning chapter works through: inconsistent crop names, stray spaces, impossible values, duplicates.

### Elevator tickets {.unnumbered}

- [`elevator_tickets.csv`](practice/data/elevator_tickets.csv) / [`elevator_tickets_semicolon.csv`](practice/data/elevator_tickets_semicolon.csv) -- the same small set of delivery tickets saved with comma and semicolon delimiters, for Module 3's file-formats section.

### Crop prices {.unnumbered}

- [`crop_prices.csv`](practice/data/crop_prices.csv) -- a handful of illustrative crop prices used in Module 5's examples. Not market data.
